strips.title: The hook (0:00-0:09)
strips.note: A dark stage. A single white card types out "How coffee works" letter by letter, then four bars grow up from its base one after another; the last bar is red and taller than the rest. A small red dot settles under it.

strips.title: From the bean (0:09-0:31)
strips.note: A whip-pan to a row of three labeled jars (GREEN, ROASTED, GROUND). Each jar lifts as it's named.

strips.title: The vertical (9:16) version: six moments
strips.note: The same video re-laid-out for a phone: the card sits higher and the jars stack instead of standing in a row.
